title: Minimum Repayment Interest Paid on Network Participation Agreements by Status and Tenure
content:
Repayment interest that Cascade owes on a repayment of an over-recovery under the Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement, one of the **Network Participation Agreements**, is paid only when it reaches a minimum. This page sets that minimum by the agreement's status and how long it has been in force.

**Clause.** The repayment interest minimum is set by the agreement's status and tenure:

- for an agreement in termination pending or terminated status, repayment interest of any amount is paid;
- for any other agreement in force 96 whole months or more from its effective date, the minimum is 1.00 USD;
- otherwise this clause does not lower the minimum.

## Terms

- **Status** is read from the agreement record. Termination pending is the status between a termination notice and the termination date; terminated is the status after it.
- **Whole months** are the difference in calendar months from the effective date to today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the effective date's day of the month.

## Applying the minimum

The repayment interest is first worked out and rounded half up to the cent. It is then compared with the minimum: interest of at least the minimum is paid, and interest below it is not.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Agreement | Interest worked out | Paid? |
|---|---|---|
| Termination pending, 30 months in force | 0.40 USD | Yes, any amount is paid |
| Active, 100 whole months in force | 1.00 USD | Yes, it reaches 1.00 USD |
| Active, 100 whole months in force | 0.99 USD | No |
| Active, 95 whole months in force | 1.50 USD | Not lowered by this clause |
